step: S2 (plans/ROADMAP.md): establish a valid seed measurement (S2a) on a traced night, full-06
question: With the cameras' own slow pan removed, does a state on the measured seed's generator cycle near the model's draw count reproduce the camera static's flicker in held-out winding windows better than chance?

hypothesis.source: docs/evidence/full06-static-readout-confirm-20261001.json (NOT_SUPPORTED, 1 of 4 hits, raw period means). Retained native frames of the camera view (artifacts/campaign-2026-09-27T19-30-35.284Z lifecycle frames 00011 and 00015) show the camera picture panning sideways on its own, so the period means carry a slow drift under the static's 0.1 s steps. Exploratory, on already-seen windows only: removing a centred 5-period running mean from both series lifts the same seed-cycle offsets, wind-1 d 6 from r 0.497 to 0.673 and wind-2 d 8 from 0.734 to 0.786, against 400 random states whose detrended r reach 0.68 and 0.56 at most.
hypothesis.statement: E-seed-ahead, read without the pan: the measured seed is right and the phone spends a few more draws than the model.

heldOut: wind-7..wind-10, the winding windows at 70-104 s; no state was scored on them before this file. Only their frames, period counts (31-32) and the model's draw counts at injection (2592, 3069, 3365, 3837) were computed. wind-1..wind-6 are excluded: all were seen.
family: As docs/evidence/full06-static-readout-predeclaration-20261001.json: every generator state written into the model after each window's injection update, its predicted static opacity correlated with the retained frames' period-mean luma, both series detrended by a centred 5-period running mean (phone-static-readout.mjs detrend).

decisionRule.text: Per window: every state is scanned with the detrended statistic; among the measured seed's cycle states at the model's own draw count by the injection plus d, d in -100..100 (201 states), take the best r. Its p-value is 1 - F(r)^201, F the window's empirical distribution of detrended r over all 65,536 states. A window hits at p < 0.01. SUPPORTED when at least 2 of the 4 windows hit (chance about 0.06%), else NOT_SUPPORTED. The best d per window is reported, not tested.

stoppingRule.text: Four windows, every state, once. No window, radius, detrend width or threshold changes after the run; a different detrend is a new predeclaration on other windows.

rung: None. SUPPORTED would support the measured seed at full-06 and make the detrended static readout an instrument for S2a and S4; it is not an outcome claim.
